title: Core 11-Woman #14
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 16:9 aspect ratio, significantly wider than it is tall, eleven women in a single row.

A photograph of ELEVEN women standing side by side in a single row at the same ground level on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, each woman in her own distinct pose, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, all real photographic skin with visible pores, no illustration finish, no CG sheen, all faces, hands and feet in correct proportion. The camera set back so all 11 fit comfortably within the wide frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render. Exactly 11 women, no more, no fewer.

Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Korean najeon mother-of-pearl lacquer (glossy black lacquer with shimmering mother-of-pearl vines), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 11, catching each woman's own painted pattern and piercings distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 16:9 landscape 8K.
